RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of discrimination; municipal interview panels are typically formed based on organizational roles and availability, not gender. At the director level, hiring decisions frequently prioritize leadership, political acumen, and public consultation over specific master’s degrees or years of technical service. Furthermore, a two-week delay for written feedback is standard municipal bureaucracy rather than an indicator of bad faith. 

Raising gender bias without concrete evidence—such as documented procedural breaches or discriminatory remarks—will appear baseless and could severely damage your professional reputation in municipal government. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting feedback on how you can strengthen your interview performance and candidacy for future leadership roles.
